scope: Independent CPU geometry, foundations, continuous LOD and main/shadow field checks; no visual acceptance or GPU measurement.

tests.name: all 36 tree buffers have physical leaves, fixed roots and conservative actual wind envelopes
LOD crowns retain actual directional silhouettes and every authored cluster rather than just copied bounds
architecture variants change actual branching topology or rigid-transform-invariant proportions
actual cells retain grounded trunks and share continuous main-camera weights with all shadow and merged levels

geometry.limits: All actual vertices; conservative coefficient envelope, not a GPU wind simulation. Triangle totals are recorded, not raised into an aesthetic threshold.

crownLod.method: Actual vertex global support functions in 16 azimuths; actual indexed triangle surfaces clipped into 8 height bands; nearest actual leaf vertex to every near crown cluster. Metadata common sphere equality is not a silhouette criterion.

architecture.method: Connected actual wood components and pairwise centroid distances normalized by actual height; invariant to uniform scale, translation and rotation. Same seed per species.

cells.limitations: Synthetic cropped population uses real placement/render builders. Allocated all-level triangles are not visible draw calls or GPU cost; shader hooks and shared uniform ownership are checked without compiling GLSL or proving visual dither quality.
